description: This file defines the MultiComparisonNode class, which models a comparison node used in abstract syntax trees (ASTs) for predicate expressions in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It supports operations like 'IN' and holds details about comparison type, property, and values.

classes.name: MultiComparisonNode
classes.description: A node representing multi-valued comparison operations, such as 'IN', within an AST for predicate expressions.

classes.name: MultiComparisonNode.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of comparison types supported by MultiComparisonNode, currently only 'IN'.

methods.name: MultiComparisonNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing the node with a comparison type, property, and list of values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the node's list of comparison values.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor to perform operations on this node in the visitor pattern.
